execution.affinity_rule: one thread per physical core first, then SMT siblings alternating CCDs; the rest reserved (host, UI, coordinator)
execution.dispatch_note: 2026-11-06 after pilot_b64_w25_r1: all workers start together (was 2 per 0.25 s sample). A staggered ramp left few cores busy, and single-core boost then drove Tctl past 95 C at start-up (run-1 resume, 2.3 s). Execution-only: labels cannot depend on it.

machine.cgroup_note: flatpak sandbox: no /sys/fs/cgroup and no systemd-run; affinity + process count + nice are the only controls
